subject: COVID-19 Emergency Housing Information Session
overview: Housing Medford and the City of Medford co-hosted a public information session detailing emergency rental assistance, public housing vouchers, and legal resources available to residents during the COVID-19 pandemic. Regional service providers presented their assistance programs and answered community questions regarding application procedures and eligibility.

items.title: Welcome and Overview of Municipal Housing Initiatives
items.summary: Representatives from Housing Medford and the Office of Community Development introduced the session and encouraged public participation in the city's ongoing Housing Production Plan process.

items.title: Presentations by Housing Service Providers
items.summary: Representatives from ABCD, Metro Housing Boston, Housing Families, and the Medford Housing Authority outlined available emergency rental assistance, eviction defense services, public housing vouchers, and property tax relief.

items.title: Public Question and Answer Session
items.summary: Panelists addressed resident questions regarding income calculation for emergency rental aid, qualification rules for roommates on shared leases, and housing authority waiting list procedures.
